newsitem.title: USA: Life USA to launch advertising campaign.
newsitem.headline: Life USA to launch advertising campaign.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc said Thursday it will launch a three-prong advertising and sales promotional effort tied to its upcoming 10th anniversary. The company has retained the Minneapolis advertising agency Fallon McElligott to develop the national campaign, which includes promotions at national air shows and the sponsorship of professional golfer Brett Quigley. Print ads will also appear in more than 20 national publications between February and June, Life USA said. A company spokeswoman said the campaign is expected to cost a total of between $3 million and $3.5 million.
Life USA is an insurance and marketing company.
Its shares were trading down 1/8 at 10-5/8.
